picker.hint: Click a window · drag a region · S whole screen · Esc cancel
notify.limit: You can have up to %1 PiPs at once.
panel.help: Pick any window, or drag a region of the screen, and it stays in a small live window above everything. Right-click the bar icon to start.
settings.hideWhenSourceVisible: Hide while the window is on screen
help.visibility: Whether a new PiP follows you to every workspace or stays on the one it was made on. Change it per PiP with the pin button.
help.size: How wide a new PiP starts, as a share of the screen. Resize it any time with the wheel.
help.corner: Where a new PiP lands. More PiPs stack beside it.
help.hover: What a PiP does under the pointer: grow, fade away so you can see beneath it, jump to the other side (hold Alt to grab it), or nothing.
help.hoverScale: How much a PiP grows on hover.
help.opacity: Opacity of every PiP at rest. Ctrl+wheel changes one PiP.
help.radius: Corner rounding. Auto follows Hyprland's rounding.
help.animation: How animated everything is. Calm matches the rest of the shell; omarchy toggle animations turns it all off.
help.refresh: Frames per second. Live is smooth; slower rates save power for things that change little.
help.layer: Above windows, or above everything including fullscreen windows.
help.background: What shows through windows that are themselves translucent, like terminals.
help.thumbs: Docked PiPs show as live thumbnails beside the bar icon.
help.peek: Hovering a thumbnail opens a large live preview.
help.shadow: A soft shadow under each PiP.
help.snap: A dropped PiP snaps to nearby screen edges and corners.
help.hideWhenSourceVisible: Hide a window's PiP while that window is on screen, since you can already see it.
help.closeWhenSourceCloses: Close a PiP when its window closes.
help.paintCursor: Draw the mouse pointer inside the PiP.
help.leftClick: What clicking the bar icon does.
help.middleClick: What middle-clicking the bar icon does.
help.rightClick: What right-clicking the bar icon does.
picker.tagScreen: Whole screen · drag for a region
